production.direction_en: A reflection moves in the altar's polished black stone after the others leave. A man in a travel-stained chancellor's coat steps through it, carrying a watch with no hands. Yseldra appears in the reflected archway, her veil lifted for the first time.
production.music_direction_en: bgm_clockless — full statement: pizzicato that never resolves; cut to silence on 'Uncle.'; bgm_main_theme over the ending card

commands.speaker: lord_cael_veyr
commands.text: You have finally told him the truth. How considerate of you to wait until the hour was nearly gone.

commands.speaker: lord_cael_veyr
commands.text: Lord Cael Veyr. The Clockless Chancellor, if titles still comfort anyone.

commands.speaker: lord_cael_veyr
commands.text: The court recorded my death. It did not record where my missing hour went.

commands.speaker: lord_cael_veyr
commands.text: I made a door. Yseldra chose who would stand in it.

commands.speaker: lady_yseldra_vale
commands.text: Do not mistake him for your answer, Fadyme. He only knows how to turn grief into a bargain.

commands.speaker: lord_cael_veyr
commands.text: Come to the Clockless Court, Mahmut. I can return the hours the curse has taken. The price is one hour that belongs to you.

commands.speaker: lord_cael_veyr
commands.text: Then she keeps fading, and you keep learning what 'too late' means.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: Mahmut, do not answer him tonight.

commands.speaker: narrator
commands.text: The handless watch ticked once. Somewhere below the altar, a bell answered.
